plain: A person who transfers property or a right to another.

webster.text: The person who grants; one who conveys lands, rents, &c.

example.quote: and how are the encroachments of the stronger to be prevented, or the wrongs of the weaker to be redressed, without an appeal to the people themselves, who, as the grantors of the commissions, can alone declare its true meaning, and enforce its observance?
